visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: yield Placed After the Update
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The sequence should start 0, 1, 1 and stay below the limit, but it starts at 1 and ends with 55, which is above the limit of 50.

solution.explanation: The loop condition checks the old value of a, but yield now hands out the new one, which has not been checked. The first value 0 is skipped and the last value can exceed the limit. Yield the value that was just tested, then update.
